title: Lentil Dal
description: Creamy spiced red lentils simmered with tomato and coconut milk. Cosy and cheap.
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in olive oil, then stir in the curry powder.
Add the lentils, tomato, coconut milk, and enough water to cover.
Simmer for 25–30 minutes until the lentils are soft, seasoning with salt.
